svg.title: 候選演化樹狀態與 canonical SNV row 共同經由 CCF、purity、CN、multiplicity 與 read evidence 評分，形成候選樹 posterior。

text.data-meaning: Small label identifying this reusable model-process component.
Title states the single visual claim of the component.

svg.text: 候選演化樹如何變成 posterior 分數

text.data-meaning: Subtitle summarizes the top-to-bottom stages without introducing a second claim.

svg.text: 從候選狀態、CCF 推導，到 likelihood 與 posterior 評分

rect.data-meaning: Observation lane kept outside the latent candidate-state stages.

image.data-meaning: Canonical SNV row icon: the data-input observation unit that feeds model scoring.

text.data-meaning: Names the observation unit supplied by data input.
Lists the observation fields carried by the canonical row.

svg.text: identity · REF/ALT reads · rho_ASCAT · major/minor/total CN

rect.data-meaning: Stage one container for candidate latent state.
Stage one marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the candidate-state stage.
Stage one names the candidate tree, clone fraction, and SNV assignment.

image.data-meaning: Candidate tree T, using the converged fixed k=3 topology asset.
Clone-local fractions eta shown on the candidate tree.
SNV assignment z shown as the mapping from an SNV to a clone.

text.data-meaning: Label disambiguates the topology asset as T.
Label disambiguates the fraction asset as clone-local eta.
Label disambiguates the assignment asset as z.

line.data-meaning: Directional flow from candidate state to cumulative CCF derivation.

path.data-meaning: Arrowhead marks the direction of model-scoring flow.

rect.data-meaning: Stage two container for cumulative CCF derivation.
Stage two marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the CCF derivation stage.
Stage two names cumulative clone prevalence, distinct from local eta.

image.data-meaning: Eta-to-phi asset visualizes cumulative CCF over the tree.

text.data-meaning: Cumulative CCF formula: local fraction plus descendant fractions.
Explains the position-based accumulation that yields phi/CCF.

svg.text: 把 clone-local η 沿樹向下累積

text.data-meaning: Names the resulting cellular prevalence interpretation of CCF.

svg.text: 得到該 clone 的 cellular prevalence

line.data-meaning: Directional flow from CCF derivation to joint purity/CN/multiplicity constraints.

path.data-meaning: Arrowhead marks the direction of model-scoring flow.

rect.data-meaning: Stage three container for the shared emission constraints.
Stage three marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the purity/CN/multiplicity stage.
Stage three explicitly states that purity, CN context, and multiplicity jointly enter the expected ALT probability.

svg.text: 共同進入 ξ：purity + CN context + multiplicity

image.data-meaning: Fixed ASCAT purity context supplied by the canonical data boundary.
ASCAT segment context supplies major_cn, minor_cn, and total_cn at the SNV locus.
Model-generated multiplicity candidate cue constrained by the copy-number context.

text.data-meaning: Label identifies the purity input role.
Label identifies the local copy-number input role.
Label identifies multiplicity as an internally generated candidate set.

line.data-meaning: Directional flow from shared constraints to expected ALT probability.

path.data-meaning: Arrowhead marks the direction of model-scoring flow.

rect.data-meaning: Stage four container for the expected ALT probability.
Stage four marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the expected ALT probability stage.
Stage four names the candidate-specific expected ALT probability.

svg.text: 預期 ALT 機率 ξ_i(g)

rect.data-meaning: Probability scale frame from zero to one.
Filled probability bar; width equals 540 × xi_expected_alt_probability.

text.data-meaning: Lower endpoint of the expected ALT probability scale.
Displayed expected ALT probability derived from the same quantity that controls bar length.
Upper endpoint of the expected ALT probability scale.
Disambiguates xi from the observed read fraction.

svg.text: 不是 observed VAF；是 candidate g 下的 expected ALT probability

line.data-meaning: Directional flow from expected ALT probability to observed read evidence and likelihood.

path.data-meaning: Arrowhead marks the direction of model-scoring flow.

rect.data-meaning: Stage five container for observed read evidence and likelihood.
Stage five marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the read-evidence likelihood stage.
Stage five compares observed REF/ALT read counts with expected ALT probability to obtain likelihood.

svg.text: 實際 REF／ALT read counts → likelihood

image.data-meaning: IGV-style read pileup asset showing observed REF and ALT counts.

text.data-meaning: Comparison marker between expected probability and observed evidence.
Names the probability of the observed reads under the candidate emission.
Compact likelihood symbol for the observed REF/ALT read evidence.
Compact likelihood model annotation connecting counts to xi.

line.data-meaning: Directional flow from read likelihood to posterior scoring.

path.data-meaning: Arrowhead marks the direction of model-scoring flow.

rect.data-meaning: Stage six container for posterior combination and candidate-tree scoring.
Stage six marker; the number encodes sequence position categorically.

text.data-meaning: Categorical stage number for the posterior stage.
Stage six states the Bayesian combination that yields the candidate-tree posterior score.

rect.data-meaning: Prior contribution box for tree, eta, and assignment structure.

text.data-meaning: Prior term over candidate tree state and assignments.
Multiplication combines prior and likelihood.

rect.data-meaning: Likelihood contribution box carried from observed reads.

text.data-meaning: Likelihood term from observed REF/ALT reads under xi.

line.data-meaning: Directional link from prior-times-likelihood to posterior.

rect.data-meaning: Posterior score result for the candidate tree.

text.data-meaning: Posterior score assigned to the candidate tree given the canonical data.
